raw_market.question: Spread: Seahawks (-3.5)
raw_market.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between 49ers and Seahawks, scheduled for October 11 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if the Seahawks win the game by 4 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "49ers".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
